title: Despite finishing a full win with two companions (Vell, Tamsin) through dozens of shared decision points, I never once saw a 'both companions look at you' quarrel prompt or the 'entry to leave a quarrel between them' the brief specifically asked me to try — it may need a third companion or specific locations I skipped (Wickstead's 'Whose Ground', the Meres' 'Old Dams', the Kings' Rest), but nothing in-game signals what triggers it.
